purpose: Reconcile every non-verified program acceptance criterion against current evidence so a local green verifier, one host-observability decision, or one completed PoC cannot be mistaken for final program closeout.

gateClusters.currentBoundary: The mother-framework, full software lifecycle, and end-to-end process fidelity have bounded evidence but not full live, domain, longitudinal, or cross-host validation. The AI-independent hard-standard boundary now has a verified fail-closed mechanism, without admitting a real standard.
gateClusters.nextEvidenceClass: named remaining domain or process-fidelity live evidence with frozen hard standards and affected-subject or domain review where applicable

gateClusters.currentBoundary: The synthetic repository-authored admission gate now fails closed, but native/runtime and reviewed alternatives have not been exhausted with admissible live attribution, so no residual gap or repository-authored payload need is proved.
gateClusters.nextEvidenceClass: exact candidate admission and attributable comparison before any authoring or portfolio preference

gateClusters.currentBoundary: Decision-ready projection, consumer mapping, CC Switch source preservation, and foreign-managed coexistence remain partial because physical, database, projection, loader, backup/restore, and cross-device layers are not converged.
gateClusters.nextEvidenceClass: read-only per-consumer authority reconciliation plus separately authorized supported recovery or convergence canaries

gateClusters.currentBoundary: The reusable standard-candidate package now has one bounded AI-era research contract and deterministic negative tests, but repeated cross-host value, CALIBRATION review, ASSETS admission, and the graph-scoped revalidation cascade remain open.
gateClusters.nextEvidenceClass: repeated source-bound candidate evidence across task or host boundaries plus a bounded affected-node revalidation proof without big-bang migration

gateClusters.currentBoundary: Dynamic MCP control, optional Hook value, and native task orchestration remain partial; current single-host and offline evidence does not prove task-scoped lifecycle, loader causation, or cross-host behavior.
gateClusters.nextEvidenceClass: named current-host capability gap with task-bound observability and authority, or a dated negative admission when the host lacks the surface

gateClusters.currentBoundary: The cleanup inventory is governed and locally verifiable, but exact retain/archive/migrate/delete dispositions and separate cleanup authority are not complete.
gateClusters.nextEvidenceClass: exact-target disposition and separately authorized cleanup followed by repository and evidence re-verification

butterflyPremiseChecks.premise: Choosing the loader attribution boundary is the only remaining closeout decision.
butterflyPremiseChecks.evidence: Fifteen criteria across six clusters remain non-verified.

butterflyPremiseChecks.premise: A passing top-level verifier proves final program completion.
butterflyPremiseChecks.evidence: The verifier validates the current contract while the canonical acceptance map still contains fifteen partial criteria.

butterflyPremiseChecks.premise: Static overlap can justify Skill retirement or external replacement.
butterflyPremiseChecks.evidence: The subtractive reconciliation retains candidates only for ablation and permits a final admitted self-authored payload count of zero.

butterflyPremiseChecks.premise: A clean governed temporary-root inventory authorizes cleanup.
butterflyPremiseChecks.evidence: Inventory conformance and cleanup authority are separate gates.

closeoutDecision.nextBoundedAction: Advance open criteria by evidence cluster while preserving the exact-loader trust decision as one independent gate; do not concentrate all remaining work into the weak-model factorial.
